notes: arXiv 2604.16209, posted 2026-04-20. 'Towards Ultra-High-Rate Quantum Error Correction with Reconfigurable Atom Arrays.' Uses non-commuting affine permutation qLDPC codes co-designed for neutral-atom AOD (Acousto-Optic Deflector) row-column movement. Encoding rate > 50% (physical-to-logical ratio ~2:1 — best demonstrated in any architecture). Code 1: 1,152 phys -> 580 logical, error rate ~2.9e-11 per logical per round. Code 2: 2,304 phys -> 1,156 logical, error rate ~1.3e-13 per logical per round (at circuit-level noise p=0.1%). Syndrome extraction in constant time. Reaches 'Teraquop' regime. IMPORTANT: these are simulation results, not hardware demonstration — the physical qubit count is the simulated code size, not a deployed machine. RELEVANCE TO OUR WORK: 2:1 ratio means ~32 physical qubits could encode our 16 logical qubits for chi=3 transport circuit — within Aquila's 256-atom budget. This directly changes the economics of fault-tolerant holographic force measurement.
